id: title:Gilbert09:explain why select all skips default off tables

review.posthog_relevance: Changes warehouse source wizard UX and selection behavior, potentially affecting warehouse ingestion setup and user understanding of skipped tables.
review.reason: Adds typed parameters and a conditional toast notification to the warehouse source wizard's table selection action. The code explicitly checks if tables are skipped due to being 'off by default' and displays a toast notification, while also adding a corresponding test assertion. This represents a localized, bounded improvement to the warehouse ingestion setup workflow.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the skipped tables were previously confusing or caused silent failures; the toast is a UX improvement rather than a critical reliability fix. No broader systemic changes or adoption metrics are demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
